div.div: مُتَيَّمٌ Enslaved, and brought into subjection, by love: (S:) having the heart enslaved, and brought into subjection, and affected with vehement love so as to be deprived of his reason: (Abu-l-'Abbás El-Ahwal, TA:) or deprived of his reason; disordered therein; by women; as also ↓ مَتِيمٌ : and led astray. (T.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
